user.description: Choose the BM6 battery monitor to add.

bluetooth_confirm.description: Do you want to set up {name}?

abort.no_devices_found: No devices found on the network
abort.not_supported: This device is not a BM6 battery monitor.

data_description.poll_interval: How often to connect and read the battery.
data_description.keep_connected: Keep the Bluetooth connection open so the monitor streams live readings, like the app's main screen. Uses a Bluetooth connection slot permanently.
data_description.auto_history: Fetch the voltage log the BM6 records every 2 minutes and import it into long-term statistics, filling gaps when the car was away.
data_description.soc_curve: Only for the custom battery types: 11 comma-separated voltages for 100%, 90%, … 0% state of charge, e.g. 12.9, 12.8, 12.7, 12.6, 12.5, 12.4, 12.3, 12.2, 12.1, 12.0, 11.9

error.invalid_curve: Enter exactly 11 voltages between 2.6 and 40.9, separated by commas.

not_found.message: BM6 {address} is not in range of a connectable Bluetooth adapter.

unknown_device.message: That device is not a BM6 battery monitor.

curve_required.message: Set a custom SoC curve in the integration options before choosing a custom battery type.

sync_history.name: Download history
sync_history.description: Downloads the 2-minute log stored on the BM6 and imports it into long-term statistics. Returns the engine trips found.

full.name: Full download
full.description: Download everything stored (31 or 72 days) instead of only what is new.

charging_test_step.name: Charging system test step
charging_test_step.description: Runs one step of the app's 3-step charging system test. Step 1: engine idling with all loads on. Step 2: loads off, engine held at 2500-3000 RPM. Step 3: idling with loads off. The result is returned after step 3.
